_source: Copied from the retention analysis's next_offer_scores.json v 2026-10-16.2 (made 2026-10-16T17:2xZ). The VALUE key web_quiz_next_offer_weights (same shape) overrides this file without a deploy.
metric: score = adjusted lift in SELF-INITIATED next-day return (percentage points) vs ending the sitting with nothing, for a child who takes this next thing. 'Self-initiated' = the return is not on a teacher link created after the finish. Logistic g-computation, cluster bootstrap by teacher (300 reps), Holm across contrasts. ci = 95% for the lift.
read_me: Within a context, rank by score; null scores go after scored kinds unless a rule/pin applies.
'significant' means the kind beats STOPPING. No kind significantly beats another kind tonight; the order among significant kinds is itself a prior.
Selection: children who choose one more thing were already keener; adjustment narrows it, cannot remove it. Only the rand arm gives causal answers.
Offered position was never logged; every score is for TAKING a kind, not for being OFFERED it.

after_quiz.note: A video picked from the library/'watch more' right after a quiz. Significant ONLY vs ending the sitting (Holm p<0.001; self-initiated next-day return 17.3% vs 5.6%). Its lead over 'play again' (+3.0 pp [-1.1, 7.2], Holm p=0.49) is NOT significant: order between these two is a prior.
after_quiz.data: replica 7-15 Oct (hub era), 5,660 child-days, self-initiated D1

after_quiz.note: Play the same (or an earlier) quiz again. Significant vs ending (Holm p<0.001). Also the only after-scorecard action significant on the phone-level data: +9.0 pp D1, OR 1.50 [1.19-1.89], Holm p=0.009.
Another teacher quiz not yet played (IA step 1 pins it anyway). Holm p=0.32 vs ending in the hub era; significant pooled Sep-Oct (+5.7 pp self D1).

Invite a friend (share a challenge link). Phone-level after-scorecard model (Axiom 10-15 Oct, n=3,099 phone-days): (ANY next-day return, not self-initiated: a different metric from the replica rows) adjusted +3.8 pp next-day return, OR 1.19 [0.97-1.47], Holm p=1.00.

Share my card (the share doubles as the invite). Phone-level after-scorecard model (Axiom 10-15 Oct, n=3,099 phone-days): (ANY next-day return, not self-initiated: a different metric from the replica rows) adjusted +3.7 pp next-day return, OR 1.19 [1.00-1.41], Holm p=0.76.

A Jugnu game/stop (n=50 phone-days took one after a scorecard: too few). Phone-level after-scorecard model (Axiom 10-15 Oct, n=3,099 phone-days): (ANY next-day return, not self-initiated: a different metric from the replica rows) adjusted +0.8 pp next-day return, OR 1.04 [0.59-1.83], Holm p=1.00.
No NIETE data: stories/storybooks did not exist. Ranked by the operator's priority (point 8) and the child-app design; the 'rand' arm is how it earns a score.
As story. Rumi Global send counts are menu-order effects, not a quality signal; not used.
No data (Jugnu's Book is not on prod).
